text: /* @component: .fade-slider-section */ (function () { function initFadeSwiper() { if (typeof Swiper !== 'undefined') { document.querySelectorAll('.fadeSwiper').forEach(function (el) { if (el.dataset.init === 'true') return; el.dataset.init = 'true'; new Swiper(el, { loop: true, effect: 'fade', fadeEffect: { crossFade: true }, speed: 1000, autoplay: { delay: 4000, disableOnInteraction: false }, allowTouchMove: false, observer: true, observeParents: true }); }); } else { setTimeout(initFadeSwiper, 150); } } if (!document.getElementById('swiper-css')) { const link = document.createElement('link'); link.id = 'swiper-css'; link.rel = 'stylesheet'; link.href = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.css'; document.head.appendChild(link); } let script = document.getElementById('swiper-js'); if (!script) { script = document.createElement('script'); script.id = 'swiper-js'; script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js'; script.onload = initFadeSwiper; document.head.appendChild(script); } else if (typeof Swiper === 'undefined') { script.addEventListener('load', initFadeSwiper); } else { initFadeSwiper(); } })(); /* @end: .fade-slider-section */
